questions.name: Field Completeness
questions.description: Proportion of mandatory schema fields populated (id, title, description, keywords, license)
questions.evidence: id: https://chorus4ai.org/; title: 'Patient-Focused Collaborative Hospital Repository Uniting Standards (CHoRUS) for Equitable AI'; description present (~1400 chars); keywords: 26 entries; license_and_use_terms: 'CHoRUS Controlled Access License with Data Use Agreement'
questions.quality_note: All five mandatory fields present and populated with substantive content (5/5 = 100%).

questions.name: Entry Length Adequacy
questions.description: Whether narrative fields have meaningful content length
questions.evidence: description spans ~1400 chars covering scope, 20 centers, modalities, OMOP standardization, and Aug-2025 statistics; motivation captured via four detailed 'purposes' entries each >250 chars
questions.quality_note: Narrative fields far exceed the 200-char threshold with rich, specific content.

questions.name: Keyword Diversity
questions.description: Number of unique keywords describing topic coverage
questions.evidence: 26 unique keywords including 'CHoRUS', 'critical care', 'OMOP Common Data Model', 'waveform telemetry', 'DICOM', 'EEG', 'OHNLP', 'health equity', 'social determinants of health', 'federated access', 'multi-modal data'
questions.quality_note: 26 diverse, domain-relevant keywords greatly exceed the 8-keyword threshold.

questions.name: File Enumeration and Type Variety
questions.description: Number of files and file type diversity in distribution_formats
questions.evidence: distribution_formats lists 5 distinct formats: OMOP CDM (structured EHR), WFDB (waveform), DICOM (imaging), OHNLP-tokenized TXT (clinical notes), EDF+/Persyst (EEG); distributions section enumerates 5 matching distribution objects
questions.quality_note: Five distinct multi-modal file types, well above the >3 threshold.

questions.name: Data File Size Availability
questions.description: Presence of file size or dimensional metadata
questions.evidence: '1.6 billion rows' of EHR OMOP data; '23 TB of waveform data'; '7,642 admissions with radiology data'; '1,000 images currently available'; '50,000 patient admissions'; 'over 45,000 unique admissions'
questions.quality_note: Abundant numeric size/dimension metadata across modalities. Pass.

questions.name: Dataset Identification Metadata
questions.description: Presence of unique identifiers such as DOI, RRID, or persistent URLs
questions.evidence: Persistent project URL page: https://chorus4ai.org/; publication DOI: 10.1007/s12028-024-02007; NIH RePORTER persistent link https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/10472824; grant ID OT2OD032701
questions.quality_note: Multiple persistent identifiers/links present (page URL, DOI, NIH RePORTER). Pass.

questions.name: Funding and Acknowledgements Completeness
questions.description: Presence of funding sources, grants, or institutional sponsors
questions.evidence: funders: 'NIH Common Fund Bridge2AI Program ... grant OT2OD032701 (project number 1OT2OD032701-01) ... Opportunity Number: OTA-21-008 ... Total funding in 2022: $5,880,300 ... Project dates: September 1, 2022 to November 30, 2026 ... Assistance Listing Number: 93.310'
questions.quality_note: Comprehensive: funding agency, full award number, amount, opportunity/study-section details, and dates.

questions.name: Ethical and Privacy Declarations
questions.description: Presence of deidentification methods, IRB approvals, or ethical sourcing notes
questions.score_label: IRB approval + deidentification + ethical sourcing details
questions.evidence: ethical_reviews: 'IRB approvals at 14 acquisition centers ... Community-facing ethics focus groups'; is_deidentified: 'EHR data de-identified through OMOP CDM transformation and privacy scanning tools (privacy_scan_tool) ... OHNLP tokenization ... DICOM header de-identification'; regulatory_restrictions cite HIPAA and 45 CFR 46
questions.quality_note: IRB approvals, detailed multi-modal deidentification methods, and ethical sourcing (focus groups) all documented.

questions.name: Access Requirements Documentation
questions.description: Whether access policy and license are clearly defined
questions.score_label: License + Data Use Agreement + platform access description
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'controlled access requiring institutional email registration and signed licensing agreement ... users receive email with access instructions to CHoRUS secure enclave ... Access request contacts - dbold@emory.edu or jared.houghtaling@tuftsmedicine.org'
questions.quality_note: License type, DUA requirement, registration workflow, secure-enclave platform, and contacts all specified.

questions.name: Interoperability and Standardization
questions.description: Presence of standard formats, ontologies, or schema conformance
questions.evidence: OMOP Common Data Model, DICOM, WFDB (extended PhysioNet schema), OHNLP schema, EDF+/Persyst; 'validated semantic mappings ... maintained in chorus-mapping repository'; 'schema compliance validation against published metadata schemas (OMOP, DICOM, WFDB, OHNLP, EDF+, Persyst)'
questions.quality_note: Multiple international standard formats plus explicit schema-conformance/validation practices.

questions.name: Tool and Software Transparency
questions.description: Mentions of preprocessing libraries or tools used in data preparation
questions.evidence: OHNLP toolkit; privacy_scan_tool; DeGauss/UF-Geocoding; chorus_waveform repository; chorus-mapping repository; OHDSI tool stack; CHoRUSReports; visualization/annotation environment; GitHub org https://github.com/chorus-ai (28 repositories)
questions.quality_note: Rich set of named tools and repositories with URLs, but no explicit version numbers and tools are dispersed across sections rather than a dedicated software field.

questions.name: Collection Protocol Clarity
questions.description: Description completeness of participant recruitment and data acquisition
questions.score_label: Full recruitment and procedural details included
questions.evidence: acquisition_methods (5), collection_mechanisms (4), collection_timeframes, data_collectors ('14 data acquisition centers ... Chorus_SOP'), sampling_strategies ('multi-center federated sampling'), raw_data_sources (4), and missing_data_documentation; retrospective waiver-of-consent framework described
questions.quality_note: Extensive procedural, sourcing, sampling, and timeframe detail across the full collection process.

questions.name: Version History Documentation
questions.description: Presence of multiple version records and associated dates
questions.score_label: Temporal snapshots with dates but no formal versioned changelog
questions.evidence: distribution_dates: 'available beginning September 2022 ... Current release (August 2025) includes 50,000 patient admissions'; version_access: 'Version history maintained as data collection expands from 45K to target 100K+'; updates describes continuous expansion
questions.quality_note: Two temporal snapshots (2022 start, Aug 2025 current) with growth notes, but no discrete versioned releases with per-version change summaries.

questions.name: Associated Publications
questions.description: Presence of formal citations or DOI-linked references
questions.evidence: existing_uses: 'Neurocritical Care journal (doi: 10.1007/s12028-024-02007)'; external_resources: 'Published Research (Neurocritical Care) ... https://doi.org/10.1007/s12028-024-02007'
questions.quality_note: A single peer-reviewed publication with DOI is cited; no additional references or bidirectional dataset-DOI cross-links.

questions.name: Human Subject Representation
questions.description: Inclusion of human subjects, demographic diversity, or subgroup details
questions.score_label: Human data with subgroup description; limited demographic detail
questions.evidence: instances: critically ill ICU/PICU/NICU patients, 45,000+ admissions, target 100,000+; subpopulations: 'by hospital' and 'ICU, PICU, and NICU patients'; at_risk_populations note pediatric/neonatal vulnerability and SDOH; known_biases note academic-center population bias
questions.quality_note: Good population and subgroup characterization (unit type, site, at-risk groups), but lacks explicit demographic distributions (age/sex/race) and formal inclusion/exclusion criteria.

questions.name: Findability (Persistent Links)
questions.description: Dataset includes persistent URLs for access and documentation
questions.evidence: page: https://chorus4ai.org/; external_resources link to https://github.com/chorus-ai, https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/10472824, https://bridge2ai.org/chorus, https://doi.org/10.1007/s12028-024-02007
questions.quality_note: Multiple persistent external URLs for access and documentation. Pass.

questions.name: Accessibility (Access Mechanism)
questions.description: Describes how users can obtain the dataset
questions.score_label: Fully defined access path (platform, login, policy)
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms: 'complete registration form with name, institutional email ... and institution. Once approved, users receive email with access instructions to CHoRUS secure enclave'; version_access: 'register with institutional email and sign licensing agreement'; named request contacts provided
questions.quality_note: Complete access path: registration, approval, DUA, secure-enclave platform, and contact points.

questions.name: Reusability (License Clarity)
questions.description: License is clearly defined and permits identifiable reuse cases
questions.evidence: license_and_use_terms + ip_restrictions ('CHoRUS licensing agreement and NIH grant terms ... GitHub repositories use MIT and Apache-2.0'); prohibited_uses and discouraged_uses explicitly define re-identification and redistribution constraints; intended_uses enumerate permitted reuse
questions.quality_note: License and reuse conditions clearly defined, including permitted uses, software licenses, and explicit prohibitions.

questions.name: Data Integrity and Provenance
questions.description: Presence of change logs or provenance tracking
questions.score_label: Provenance and update tracking with dates; partial structured versioning
questions.evidence: updates: 'updated continuously ... Regular status updates tracked through GitHub project management system'; version_access describes versioned releases; raw_data_sources and preprocessing/cleaning strategies document provenance; extension_mechanism cites Chorus_SOP and chorus-mapping
questions.quality_note: Strong provenance (raw sources, transformation pipeline, SOP/mapping repos) and dated update tracking, but not a fully structured timestamped version-control log.

questions.name: Interlinking Across Platforms
questions.description: Metadata connects dataset records across multiple platforms
questions.evidence: external_resources link to GitHub (chorus-ai), NIH RePORTER, Bridge2AI program, AIM-AHEAD, OHDSI/OMOP, and a Neurocritical Care DOI; Chorus_SOP documentation site linked
questions.quality_note: Cross-platform interlinking to GitHub, NIH RePORTER, Bridge2AI, AIM-AHEAD, OHDSI, and a journal DOI verified. Pass.

strengths: Excellent structural completeness: all mandatory fields populated, 26 keywords, and 5 distinct multi-modal distribution formats
Comprehensive funding detail including full NIH award number (1OT2OD032701-01), amount, opportunity number, and project dates
Strong ethical/privacy documentation: IRB approvals at all 14 sites, ethics focus groups, and per-modality de-identification methods
Robust interoperability with international standards (OMOP, DICOM, WFDB, OHNLP, EDF+/Persyst) plus validated semantic mappings and schema-compliance validation
Clear, fully specified controlled-access mechanism (registration, DUA, secure enclave, named contacts) and rich cross-platform interlinking
weaknesses: Only a single associated publication DOI is cited; no additional references or bidirectional dataset-DOI cross-links
Version history is expressed as growth snapshots rather than discrete versioned releases with per-version change summaries
Human-subject representation lacks explicit demographic distributions (age/sex/race) and formal inclusion/exclusion criteria
Preprocessing/analysis tools are named with repositories but without version numbers and are not consolidated in a dedicated software field
Provenance tracking is strong but not a fully structured, timestamped version-control changelog
recommendations: Add further associated publications and a dataset DOI with bidirectional cross-links to the publication record
Introduce discrete versioned releases (e.g., v1.0 Aug 2025) each with release date and change summary in a release_notes field
Expand subpopulation metadata with demographic distributions (age, sex, race/ethnicity) and explicit inclusion/exclusion criteria
Consolidate software_and_tools with version numbers and direct repository URLs (e.g., OHNLP toolkit version, chorus_waveform, privacy_scan_tool, DeGauss)
Provide a structured, timestamped provenance/version-control log capturing per-release data and schema changes
